name: NF2, moesin-ezrin-radixin like (MERLIN) tumor suppressor

function.text: NF2 encodes merlin, a cytoskeletal and membrane-associated tumor-suppressor protein involved in cell-contact signaling and regulation of growth-control pathways.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to NF2-related schwannomatosis (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Ependymoma; Mesothelioma; Collecting duct carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
